title: Swarm of Swarms: Evolutionary Functional & 2D/3D Spatial Causal Simulation for Embodied AI
description: Mathematical specification, AI Safety alignment framework, and unified zero-leakage 2D/3D Active Inference & variational policy benchmarks (swarm_v7_core.py) for Embodied AI under non-stationary resource depletion, static correlated decoys, finite-speed causal delays, and energy winter regimes.
notes: Developed and independently audited via a triadic Human-AI methodology with ground-truth shuffling injection tests (APPROVED verdict on v5.1 2D, v6.0.0 3D, and v7.0.0 zero-leakage 2D/3D benchmarks).
